items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: She sang in a show called 'Callico' and Bix Beiderbecke took me to see that show with her.

ctx.x: Yes I have several of her records here. I have her records collector's items.

She sang in a show called 'Callico' and Bix Beiderbecke took me to see that show with her. And you could hear it, Ethel Waters. And she sang a number called 'I'm Coming Virginia'. And was it something.
Do you have that on record?
